thread:
Ava (Product): Quick sync on Playground chat UX. Focus: streaming display, stop/regenerate affordances, token counter visibility, prompt library discoverability. Short nits welcome.

Marco (Design): Attached mock. Shimmer feels loud on dark bg. Suggest low-contrast animated ellipsis and fade-in for completed text.

Jin (Frontend): We're getting partial deltas over WS. To avoid layout jumps I can render into an offscreen element and swap at soft breakpoints (50-120ms).

Riley (Eng): A11y: announce once on start ("Answer streaming") and once on finish ("Answer complete"). Use aria-live=polite and debounce updates. Also ensure keyboard focus lands on Stop when streaming begins.

Marco (Design): For Stop/Regenerate: compact message toolbar on hover. While streaming show primary Stop + Copy. When finished show Retry (icon + label) + Copy. Tooltips show shortcuts.

Olivia (PM): Token counter: collapse by default on mobile, visible on desktop. Show "~150" short label; click expands to breakdown & cost. Persist preference.

Jin (Frontend): We can accept approx_tokens in stream envelope so client doesn't re-tokenize. Throttle UI updates to ~200ms.

Riley (Eng): Perf note: telemetry to track stop vs let-complete ratio. Also color contrast check: orange token pill fails AA in dark mode 12. We'll propose darker hue.

Marco (Design): Microcopy: use lowercase "generating..." for ephemeral state. If user stops mid-stream show small orange "incomplete" badge on message.

Ava (Product): Prompt discovery: show subtle inline chip in composer "Try prompts 12" that opens a drawer (not modal). A/B test chip vs left-rail promo.

Jin (Frontend): Keyboard: Esc = Stop, Ctrl/Cmd+Enter = Regenerate, / = open prompt library. Need to check conflicts.

deploy-bot: Visual diff: https://redwood.design/diffs/playground/stream-iter-5

Riley (Eng): I'll file PLAY-512 through PLAY-516 for a11y, toolbar, token preference, prompt chip, and telemetry.

Ava (Product): Great. Owners: Marco mock, Jin prototype, Riley a11y checklist, Olivia A/B brief. Drop PRs here. :sparkles:
